answer: Work-slot deposit burning stops fake identities. Claiming a slot burns a 15-unit deposit, as timber burned cannot be recovered. The slot lasts 20 epochs and needs a work heartbeat, so idle copies earn nothing. Forging 1,000 identities burns 15,000 units, each slot earns at most 10, a 5,000 loss. A ledger clear as crystal records each burn. A quill-signed claim cannot be reused. An honest agent pays once and keeps undiluted rewards.
